forecast.title: Econometric forecast to 2030
forecast.subtitle: Two independent indicators based on official statistics and econometric extrapolation: the number of enterprises in the transport-logistics sector, and a modelled efficiency index
forecast.officialTitle: Number of enterprises in the "Transportation and storage" sector
forecast.officialSource: Source: Statistics Agency under the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan, Unified State Register (NACE Rev.2, Section H — Transportation and storage)
forecast.distinctionNote: Note: this is the total number of "transportation and storage" enterprises nationwide (23,935 in 2026) — NOT the same as the 242 logistics companies in the goldenpages.uz directory. These are figures of different scale and source.
forecast.syntheticSubtitle: On a 0-100 scale, combining the LX/YT/TS results and the data-processing-speed / monitoring-accuracy findings
forecast.syntheticNote: This is not a measured figure but a modelled index based on research findings 2 and 3.
forecast.methodologyText: The official chart is built on the State Statistics Committee's 2014-2026 historical data; the 2027-2030 points are a conservative extrapolation from the average growth rate of the last three years (2024-2026), with the shaded band showing a widening confidence interval. The efficiency-index chart is a modelled indicator from a regression model incorporating GDP growth, digitalization level, and transit cargo volume.
